gpt56ProMax.limits: The browser did not expose a fixed failure category separating host refusal from model interpretation. A later harmless Instant request also failed before browser admission on the retained failed persistence promise.

findings.verification: The helper rejected app-owned instruction envelopes prepended when changing models, and its earlier receipts did not bind an exact model and effort. The repair accepts only observed bounded envelopes and verifies native model/effort plus successful pre-Send browser family/Power.
findings.visibleAuthority: Large model-switch instruction payloads became pasted-text attachments. The visible message retained only the generation marker. A completed Pro turn's token was subsequently reused in rejected discovery requests after newer tokens had been supplied. Keep the current broker token in a separate visible directive appended after paste settlement; retain the full transcript and exact draft checks.
findings.staleTokenErrors: The MCP handler used one generic failure envelope for known inactive-token rejection before admission and errors after possible invocation. Distinguish only the proven pre-admission category. Do not expose another token, remap requests, retry native actions or weaken tool annotations.
findings.proStop: Both Pro routes acknowledged one Stop click but still showed active controls at the 2400ms script bound. An isolated GPT-6 Pro repeat with its owned tab visible reproduced the failure. The same generation later showed Stopped thinking and the idle composer without a second Stop or continuation. The new shared contract allows condition-driven confirmation within a ten-second hook deadline; time alone never proves success.
findings.persistenceRecovery: A private ACL helper timeout caused one checkpoint write to reject. Its optimistic snapshot cache and rejected write tail then blocked later native turns even after storage recovered. A new turn now explicitly reflushes the latest in-memory snapshot before browser work; old-turn replay retains the original failure. Final delivery becomes terminal only after its checkpoint is durable. The original host ACL stall was not reproduced, and file permissions or helper deadlines were not weakened.
